Requirement: Desktop client supports corporate Windows 10/11 editions approved by the company.
Target: Every company-approved Windows 10/11 image installs, launches, signs in and exits without unsupported runtime or privilege requirement.
Measurement: Versioned install/launch/sign-in/logout smoke matrix on each approved corporate image; 0 failed required step.

Requirement: All primary/destructive actions, CMP-001 and CMP-002 have keyboard-only paths.
Target: 100% primary/destructive flows and CMP-001/CMP-002 complete with Tab/Shift+Tab, Up/Down, Enter and Esc without pointer input.
Measurement: Automated UIA plus manual keyboard matrix; exact focus-return and disabled-reason assertions for every listed flow.
Source/Assumption: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation

Requirement: Focus is visible/deterministic; urgency levels/bounds and employee group/status/redaction have accessible names and states.
Target: 0 missing accessible name/role/state, active-descendant, group announcement or deterministic focus-return assertion in CMP-001/CMP-002 critical paths.
Measurement: UIA tree snapshot + Narrator/NVDA script for loading, result-group, redaction, validation, conflict, unavailable and close/Esc states.
Source/Assumption: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation

Requirement: Layouts remain usable at 100–200% Windows scaling and multiple monitors.
Target: At 100%, 150% and 200% scaling and below 1100 logical px, no critical control is clipped; reading/tab order remains logical and horizontal scroll is not required for the primary action.
Measurement: Window-size × scaling × high-contrast visual/keyboard matrix on approved Windows images.

Requirement: Status/urgency/error/redaction is never communicated by color alone; semantic text and icon/shape alternatives are present.
Target: Text/icon/state alternative for every colored signal
Source/Assumption: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation

Requirement: Large lists use server pagination and client virtualization.
Target: 0 full-dataset list requests; client retains only contract page payloads plus realized viewport and does not grow with total dataset size during bounded scroll test.
Measurement: Production-scale fixture profile: request log, page/cursor assertions, realized-item count and memory trend.

Requirement: Calendar reads are range-bounded and virtualized.
Target: 100% calendar reads include bounded from/to; 0 unbounded multi-year request; out-of-contract range returns CALENDAR_RANGE_TOO_LARGE with preserved filter state.
Measurement: Generated contract/UI tests for minimum/maximum supported ranges, DST boundaries and one over-limit range.

Requirement: Filtering and cursor pagination execute server-side before result delivery.
Target: No client post-filter of paged results

Requirement: Server outage changes application to honest read-only cache mode.
Target: 0 accepted business writes while API unavailable

Requirement: After reconnect client authenticates, applies change feed, and bootstraps when cursor/scope is invalid.
Target: No stale unauthorized projection after recovery

Requirement: All versioned writes, including urgency scale PUT/reset, require If-Match and reject stale/missing version.
Target: 100% versioned writes covered by 412/428/409 tests
Source/Assumption: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation

Requirement: Idempotent commands do not duplicate side effects for same key/hash.
Target: Exactly one business result/event for duplicate delivery

Requirement: Server evaluates authentication, capability, relation, employee visibility/redaction and filters before pagination on every request.
Target: No authorization decision based solely on UI
Source/Assumption: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation

Requirement: Tokens, passwords, secrets, raw query, PII, notification content and sensitive full paths are absent from logs/analytics.
Target: 0 secret findings in log scan
Source/Assumption: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation

Requirement: Client-server traffic uses approved TLS inside local network.
Target: 0 plaintext HTTP API endpoints; untrusted/expired/mismatched certificate is rejected and no credentials or command payload is sent.
Measurement: Deployment endpoint scan and negative TLS handshake/certificate matrix inside the approved LAN configuration.

Requirement: User-specific cache is encrypted, disposable and cleared on logout/revoke/scope changes as specified.
Target: No readable cache after cleanup

Requirement: Client maps all Stage 2.3.1 stable errors, cursor invalidation and redaction/unavailable states without raw exceptions.
Target: All stable errors mapped; no raw exception
Source/Assumption: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation

Requirement: Application never deletes or moves physical working files as a metadata side effect.
Target: 0 physical mutations in delete/move/purge tests

Requirement: OS/SMB ACL remains authoritative and failures are categorized.
Target: No ACL bypass; differentiated error

Requirement: Unsupported clients are blocked for writes; Stage 2.3.1 notification clients retain built-in urgency presentation mapping.
Target: No writable shell below min version
Source/Assumption: Stage 2.3.1 OpenAPI 1.2.0-stage2.3; Stage 3.5 UX baseline; Stage 4.3 remediation

Requirement: Audit/history is append-only and authorization/redaction aware.
Target: No update/delete path for audit; current-right filtering

Requirement: Admin UI shows backup result, last success and verification status; backup bytes are not exposed.
Target: No success claim without completed result/verification metadata

Target: Architecture target; validate with load fixtures
